item.content:encoded: We’ve extended Nrtsearch with the Inference Plugin, which embeds ML-based ranking directly in the search layer — eliminating the need for a standalone scoring service. item.title: SnooRec: A Shared Retrieval Foundation for Reddit Recommendations | RedditEng
item.description: By Jeff Mo and Christophe Hivert At Reddit scale, candidate retrieval has to serve many product surfaces with different goals. Home Feed, Notifications, and ranking systems may all need personalized c
item.content:encoded: By Jeff Mo and Christophe Hivert At Reddit scale, candidate retrieval has to serve many product surfaces with different goals. Home Feed, Notifications, and ranking systems may all need personalized candidates, but each surface optimizes for a different mix of user actions, such as clicks, upvotes, comments, or long-dwell visits. SnooRec gives all surfaces a shared retrieval foundation, with task-specific user representations, a shared item index, and a serving-time control for mixing objectives
